in_sanskrit.name: charaka
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: one who has extensive knowledge, possesses wisdom, and is proficient in various fields

in_marathi.name: Charak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charak is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chara' which means 'to move' or 'to travel'. The name is often associated with skilled and knowledgeable individuals, such as physicians or scholars. In Hindu mythology, Charak is the name of a sage and physician who is considered the author of the ancient Indian medical text, the Charaka Samhita.
